description: Uses an LLM to respond to the input.

tag.description: The tag that the output message should be tagged with
tag.title: Message Tag

llm_provider_id.description: The configured LLM service provider this node calls, e.g. the team's OpenAI account.
llm_provider_id.title: LLM Model

llm_provider_model_id.description: The model to call, e.g. gpt-4o. Must belong to the same provider type as `llm_provider_id` -- an OpenAI provider cannot run an Anthropic model.
llm_provider_model_id.title: Llm Provider Model Id

llm_model_parameters.description: Generation settings passed to the model, such as `temperature`. Which keys are accepted depends on the model; leave empty to use its defaults.
llm_model_parameters.title: Llm Model Parameters

history_type.title: PipelineChatHistoryTypes
history_type.description: Which past messages to put in the prompt. `none` sends only the current input; `node` remembers just this node's own turns; `named` shares one history between every node set to the same `history_name`; `global` uses the participant's whole conversation.

history_name.description: The shared history to read and write. Only used when `history_type` is `named`.
history_name.title: History Name

history_mode.title: PipelineChatHistoryModes
history_mode.description: How to shrink history that outgrows its limit: `summarize` replaces old messages with a summary, `truncate_tokens` drops them to fit `user_max_token_limit`, and `max_history_length` keeps only the most recent `max_history_length` messages.

user_max_token_limit.description: Maximum number of tokens before messages are summarized or truncated.
user_max_token_limit.title: Token Limit

max_history_length.description: Chat history will only keep the most recent messages up to this limit.
max_history_length.title: Max History Length

name.description: Identifies the node within its pipeline. Another node reaches this one's result through `temp_state.outputs.<name>`, so renaming it breaks any template that does.
name.title: Node Name

source_material_id.description: A reference document whose full text is made available to the prompt. Setting it requires the prompt to use `{source_material}`, and using that variable requires this to be set.
source_material_id.title: Source Material Id

prompt.default: You are a helpful assistant. Answer the user's query as best you can
prompt.description: The system prompt. May reference template variables in single braces -- `{participant_data}`, `{current_datetime}` -- each of which must appear at most once. Literal braces have to be doubled.
prompt.title: Prompt

collection_id.description: A media collection whose files the node can talk about. Setting it requires the prompt to use `{media}`, and using that variable requires this to be set.
collection_id.title: Media

collection_index_ids.description: Searchable indexes the node may retrieve from. Selecting more than one requires the prompt to use `{collection_index_summaries}` so the model can choose between them.
collection_index_ids.title: Collection Indexes

max_results.description: The maximum number of results to retrieve from the index
max_results.title: Max Results

generate_citations.description: Allow files from this collection to be referenced in LLM responses and downloaded by users
generate_citations.title: Generate Citations

tools.description: The tools to enable for the bot
tools.title: Tools

custom_actions.description: Custom actions to enable for the bot
custom_actions.title: Custom Actions

built_in_tools.description: Built in tools provided by the LLM model
built_in_tools.title: Built In Tools

mcp_tools.description: MCP tools to enable for the bot
mcp_tools.title: MCP Tools

synthetic_voice_id.description: The text-to-speech voice this node's reply is spoken in. Only applies where the chatbot has a voice provider configured, and the voice has to be one that provider can speak -- each option carries the `type` and `provider_id` to match it against. Leave unset to reply in text only.
synthetic_voice_id.title: Voice Model
